SOURCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED v2 derivative, v1 remains unchanged and unexecuted. No build/test/import/AST/lint/GPU/model/process/Git/cleanup performed.
Dependency: apply v1 production common helper/API/CMake first, then v2 one-context benchmark-only delta. Complete before copies equal v1 after; unchanged helper/header/CMake included with exact hashes for review, not whole-file consumer replacement. Base WN0691bcdf. Production common helper/backend/GRF/queue identity/exact GroupedKernel bundle gates byte-identical v1. No production change in v2.
X/W/Y are explicit aligned device-USM on diagnostic same Runtime device/context. Host source X/W and destination/sentinel Y use bounded std::vector buffers. Tiny68-byte immutable host-USM bounds alone remain host-accessible for API validation and kernel bounds read, no material shared-USM operand residency. Host reference uses original host_x/host_w and completed host_y copyback; no host dereference of device operand pointers.
Checked size_t multiply/add constructs exact logical extents, separate requested device bytes and actual vector capacity host bytes each<=192MiB; every individual device and bounds request<=reported max allocation. Host-capacity accounting includes two68-byte bounds copies but excludes allocator/runtime/compiler bookkeeping; Main finite RSS cap still required. Devices lacking device-USM/host-USM/profiling aspect return77 unavailable, never PASS. Alignment64, no allocation retries.
Three explicit H2D copies including sentinel initialization each wait_and_throw + queue wait + async latch + complete check before kernel timing; same in-order queue. Exact selected kernel event retained, waited/checked and command_start/end queried. D2H whole Y+tail sentinels after kernel completion/timestamp query, wait/check precedes host validation. H2D and D2H reported host submission-to-completion intervals, not physical DMA time/bandwidth; wholecell host interval includes Runtime initialization through successful GPU free/reference and initial compile/bundle overhead, excludes printing/host vector destructor. hostsubmit and kernel-submit-to-completion separate from event_ns. No barrier/tag substitution.
Host fixture vectors are declared outside try/catch so pending copies retain live memory through exceptional drain. Device pointers are freed only after successful queue drain; failed drain _Exit without freeing GPU or host state. Every failure stays FAILED; no PASS if event/copy/reference/drain/latch fails. Bounds remain immutable and owned until successful drain. Host source data remains alive until final completion. Main provides finite owned process wall/CPU/RSS/log/cursors and freshhealth/fault/closure gates.
Structured full-output reference and canaries unchanged in mathematical coverage; GPU groups16, GU1280/K2560 Down2560/K640, NT1/8/16/128/256, empty/ragged groups. This is diagnostic synthetic device-resident operand service time, not model residency proof, physical DMA/production roofline/critical-path/speed claim. Topk10 preserved; average160 merely hypothetical estimate, no actual model bounds inferred. All v1 qualification limits remain.
